haerin.name: 해린
haerin.design: HAERIN is a female OTTER-themed humanoid. LONG STRAIGHT SILVER ICE-BLUE HAIR nearly to feet, blunt short bangs, few large angular flowing masses, matching TEAL-BLUE eyes. Small rounded biological OTTER ears partly hidden under hat/hair; ONE smooth thick tapered SILVER-BLUE OTTER TAIL at lower back, NOT a fish/shark tail or fluffy fox tail. AQUA MINT SHARK CAP, soft bright turquoise/aqua base (#8BDDE3), darker aqua hard shadow (#50B8C5), dorsal fin, tiny dark shark dot eyes on front, PINK shark mouth and WHITE toothy brim. This is a SHARK HAT, not her face or body. Bright LIGHT-YELLOW short-sleeved hooded tunic/minidress (#FFE27A base), torso/sleeves/hem all YELLOW. Hood/collar, TWO drawstrings and TWO round toggles all WHITE. Pink-and-white chevron band across waist, small WHITE pocket appliques. Bare short legs and chunky SKY-BLUE OPEN-TOED TWO-STRAP SANDALS with visible human toes; no closed shoes or socks. Empty hands. Rear cap has back panel and dorsal fin, NO shark eyes/mouth/teeth pasted onto back; white hood visible over hair and yellow tunic back. Preserve bright yellow/white/aqua color assignment in every frame.
haerin.colorRevision: v5: bright yellow tunic + white hood/drawstrings/toggles + soft aqua mint shark cap
haerin.colorPolicy: Guides for broad generated fabric fills, no code palette quantization. Pink/white waist motif, hair/tail/eyes/skin/sandals retain approved colors.

stranger.name: 신규 이방인
stranger.profileStatus: 새 캐릭터. 이름·동물종·성격·생활 프로필은 확정하지 않음.
stranger.design: STRANGER is the currently unnamed androgynous humanoid, no visible animal ears/wings/tail. SILVER-ASH short hair with straight bangs and TWO LOW SHORT curled twintails at jaw/shoulder length, drawn as angular hooked ribbons, NOT long pigtails. Matching DEEP VIOLET eyes. WHITE WIDE-BRIMMED HAT with dark charcoal/plum band, ONE LARGE WHITE ROSE and olive-green leaves with a dark ribbon: FRONT viewerRIGHT, BACK viewerLEFT. Long WHITE split COAT with BLACK/dark inner lining and lapels over a short BLACK inner outfit. WHITE stockings and WHITE chunky ankle boots with dark soles. Exactly ONE small BOUQUET OF ABOUT FOUR RED ROSES, olive-green leaves and short brown tied stems, held in the character's LEFT HAND throughout EVERY frame: FRONT viewerRIGHT near center waist/chest; BACK viewerLEFT, peeking beyond left coat edge, attached to left hand. Keep flowers held near waist while FREE RIGHT HAND gestures/walks/cheers. Rear shows COAT BACK and split tails, not copied front lapels/chest. Rose accessory and bouquet NEVER switch physical sides or float/disappear. NO old sunset T-shirt emblem, Morse headband, black-haired outfit, particles or glow. Do not invent a personal name, species or new profile.
stranger.frontBouquetSide: viewer-right, held close to center chest/waist

danu.name: 단우
danu.design: DANU is an androgynous MALE MOLE-themed humanoid with boyish body. LONG LOOSE SILVER-WHITE HAIR past shoulders to hips, side-parted swept bangs and broad angular ends with pale-lavender hard shadow. BLACK paneled NEWSBOY CAP with short brim, not a top hat or baseball cap. Matching warm GRAY-BROWN eyes behind ROUND DARK-RIMMED GLASSES. GLASSES ARE MANDATORY in ALL front and side frames, including closed-eye/blinking/sliding/jumping/victory: complete circular near-lens ring(s), bridge and side temple stay visible. Lens is clear; don't replace glasses with naked eyelashes or opaque goggles. WHITE high-neck shirt, open PALE BLUE-and-WHITE VERTICALLY STRIPED overshirt/jacket with few broad simple stripes, BLACK BACKPACK with TWO dark shoulder straps. Full-length washed MEDIUM BLUE JEANS with TWO obvious horizontal RIPPED KNEE OPENINGS showing PALE SKIN, one on each knee, sparse short white torn threads; not white square patches and never shorts. WHITE chunky sneakers with dark soles. Small rounded mole ears partly hidden by hair, tiny smooth pinkish mole tail behind. Back shows BLACK BACKPACK centered over lower hair/torso with strap and square buckle detail; back of jeans has NO front knee holes copied onto calves. Glasses naturally hidden behind head in full rear. Empty hands; shy friendly expression.

eden.name: 이든
eden.design: 같은 이든이 얼굴이 드러나는 동물 후드형 전신 탈을 번갈아 입는다. 은백색/옅은 은청색 짧은 머리와 청회색 눈은 두 분장에서 동일하다. 기본 외형은 흰 토끼탈(분홍 귀 안감·목 리본·당근 파우치·둥근 꼬리), 대체 외형은 노란 강아지탈(늘어진 귀·크림 배·하늘색 스카프·작은 강아지 꼬리). 탈 밖에 생물학적 귀·올빼미 날개를 추가하지 않으며, 기존 비니·크로스백·케이프를 사용하지 않는다.
eden.profileNote: 외형 컨셉을 분장 캐릭터로 개편. 기존 인물의 기본 설정은 보존하며, 동물탈은 생물학적 변신이 아닌 의상이다.

Full WHITE onesie with subtly off-white belly, PINK BOW at FRONT neck, big WHITE PAW MITTENS with PINK paw pads and oversized WHITE PLUSH PAW FEET, no bare human hands/feet or separate boots.
